title: Routing
subtitle: route-to forces the next hop, reply-to forces the way back

cmds:
cat > /tmp/route.conf <<'EOF'
pass in quick proto icmp from 10.0.1.10 to 10.0.2.20 route-to { 10.0.3.2 } keep state
pass out quick
EOF
echo 'forced egress eth3 -> gw2:'; grep -c 'echo request' /tmp/gw.td; echo 'normal egress eth2 -> srv:'; grep -c 'echo request' /tmp/srv.td

cat > /tmp/reply.conf <<'EOF'
pass in quick proto icmp from 10.0.1.10 to 10.0.2.20 reply-to { 10.0.3.2 } keep state
pass out quick
EOF
echo 'reply forced onto eth3:'; grep -c 'echo reply' /tmp/rgw.td; echo 'reply on the client link:'; grep -c 'echo reply' /tmp/rcli.td
